title: Void (Within Window)
when: Ticket state = Just booked (within void window)
fl_steps: Check claimability in Edvin
Process Void in GDS (TRDC/ALL for Amadeus, etc.)
Cancel associated EMD ancillaries
Run Rebooking Wizard / Refund
forbidden: Do not process void if claimability is False
Do not forget to cancel EMDs

title: Add Ancillary (< 48h before departure)
fl_steps: Inform customer it is too close to departure (48h deadline for LCC/portal)
Escalate if strictly needed per doc
alternatives: Suggest purchasing directly at the airport
forbidden: Do not attempt to add ancillaries via GDS/Edvin <48h
handoff: Customer Care Escalations (if urgent YY needed)

title: LCC Void (Same Calendar Day)
fl_steps: Inform customer handling fees apply
Select 'Void' in Modify Order
Copy pop-up message into errand
Send CXL conf LCC void
forbidden: Never promise a full refund for LCC

title: Amadeus Rebooking (Unused Ticket)
fl_steps: Ensure Segment is HK and Ticket is O (Open)
Use FXQ/FXO to calculate
Deduct penalty manually if customer has Flexible Ticket
Send payment link
XE old segment, ER to save
Handoff to Fulfillment
alternatives: Void & Rebook if within void window (cheaper)
forbidden: Do not forget to check Flexible Ticket in Edvin

title: Name Correction (NACO <=3 chars or marriage)
fl_steps: Check 24h void rule first
Check Edvin 'NAME' tab for airline policy
Collect airline + handling fee (waived if Support Package)
Update Name & Reissue Ticket
alternatives: Void and rebook if within window
forbidden: Do not guarantee name change without checking Edvin
Brazilian customers: always initiate with airline first

title: Involuntary CXL / Rebook (Force Majeure / SC)
when: Disruption flag = Force Majeure / Schedule Change
fl_steps: Verify airline FM/SC policy in Edvin
Process involuntary refund/rebooking
Ensure NO ETG service fee is applied
forbidden: Do not apply ETG voluntary service fee
source: Lesson: Force Majeure or Schedule Change?

title: Voluntary Cancellation (Penalty + ETG Fee)
when: Fare outcome direction = Refundable w/ airline fee
fl_steps: Read fare rules in GDS/Edvin for penalty amount
Quote refund amount minus penalty and ETG handling fee
Obtain explicit customer agreement before clicking Modify
Cancel segment in GDS and create refund errand in Edvin
alternatives: Offer rebooking if passenger only wants to change dates
forbidden: Do not click Modify Order before customer clearly agrees to the refund quote
Do not guarantee refund processing time faster than standard bank timeline

title: Non-refundable Fare (Tax-Only Refund)
fl_steps: Verify non-refundable base fare & refundable tax components
Split passenger PNR first if only partial passengers are canceling
Inform customer that only airport/government taxes will be refunded minus handling fee
Obtain customer confirmation
alternatives: Offer rebooking alternative if airline allows change with penalty
Offer airline travel credit if available
forbidden: Do not cancel entire booking without splitting passenger first if partial pax
Never promise base fare refund on non-refundable tickets
source: Tax Refund Procedures & Split PNR SOP

title: Cancellation Protection / CFAR Claim
when: CXL product on order = CXL Protection / CFAR
fl_steps: Verify CFAR/Protection product active in Edvin
Check deadline (e.g., must be claimed >24h before first flight)
Guide customer to submit claim via self-service portal or process internal claim per product rule
Cancel PNR in GDS once claim is validated
alternatives: Standard airline cancellation if CFAR deadline expired
forbidden: Do not promise 100% cash refund if product covers voucher only
Do not approve claim if deadline has passed

title: Refund Status / Timeline Inquiry
when: Ticket state = Already in refund flow
fl_steps: Check Payouts tab & Edvin history for refund batch status
If within 10-15 business days standard bank turnaround, reassure customer
If exceeded SLA, check bank ARN / payout error and escalate if needed
alternatives: Provide ARN / payment proof if bank investigation needed
forbidden: Do not promise immediate same-day bank reflection
